package.description: Merge, split, extract, rotate, watermark and password-protect PDFs on your own machine.

en-GB.description: Merge, split, extract, rotate, watermark and password-protect PDFs on your own machine.
en-GB.longDescription: PDFGeek does the everyday PDF jobs locally: merge, split, extract pages, rotate, watermark and password-protect. Merging takes images as well as PDFs, with a choice of keeping each image at its own size or fitting everything to A4 or Letter. There are no file-count caps, no hourly throttle and nothing is uploaded to anyone's server.
en-GB.name: PDFGeek
